FISHING LICENCE · NETHERLANDS

Netherlands fishing licence

Most inland fishing requires a VISpas or another valid written permission. Club membership normally includes the VISpas, but it covers only the waters listed for that pass.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers in most inland waters need the applicable fishing permission.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
VISpasany1 yearSee official site

Extra stamps and permits

  • Permission for other water
    For water outside the list covered by your VISpas.

Saltwater

Marine anglers aged 14 and above must register in RecFishing, even if they hold a VISpas. Separate marine gear and catch rules apply.

Rules visitors should know

  • Check the permitted water in VISplanner and the list linked to your pass.
  • Follow the conditions for your permit and chosen water.
  • Report sea bass, bluefin tuna and European eel catches in RecFishing within 24 hours, including released fish.

How to buy

Buy a VISpas online or join an affiliated angling club. The government also describes a more limited Kleine VISpas.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Netherlands?

Most inland fishing requires a VISpas or another valid written permission. Club membership normally includes the VISpas, but it covers only the waters listed for that pass.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Netherlands?

Buy a VISpas online or join an affiliated angling club. The government also describes a more limited Kleine VISpas.
